ext.author: Author
ext.bad_json: The sample is not valid JSON.
ext.code_hint.api_endpoint: Define final class Endpoint implements ApiEndpoint; its handle() returns the JSON answer. It can read but never write.
ext.code_hint.client_field: Call lcf.field with mount(el, api) and send the value with api.setValue(). Vue can be imported from "vue" (render functions only).
ext.code_hint.client_validator: Call lcf.validator with a function of the values that returns, by field key, the message of each problem. It runs in a sandboxed frame with no network.
ext.code_hint.form_script: Call lcf.script with onChange(values, changed), returning the values to set and the messages to show.
ext.code_hint.server_hook: Define final class Hook implements ServerHook. No namespace, imports, files, network or database: use $ctx for values, $ctx->records() to read other forms and $ctx->http() to call out.
ext.delete_text: It was never deployed; its versions are removed with it.
ext.editor_fallback: The code editor could not start; a plain text box is shown instead.
ext.editor_subtitle: Write the code, test it in the sandbox, submit it for approval, then deploy it.
ext.empty_text: Until one is deployed, everything runs exactly as configured in the builder.
ext.key_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; it cannot change later.
ext.permission_hint: Checked on every call, with the caller's own record access.
ext.point.onAction: After an action runs on a record
ext.point_hint.afterDelete: It runs inside the deletion; failing undoes it.
ext.point_hint.afterSave: It runs inside the save; failing undoes the save.
ext.point_hint.beforeSave: It may change values; the record is validated again before it is written.
ext.point_hint.beforeValidate: It may change values and add field errors; formulas and validation run after it.
ext.point_hint.onAction: extra() holds the action; failing marks that record as failed in the run.
ext.point_hint.onLoad: It may change what is shown; the stored record is never changed.
ext.point_hint.onStatusChange: extra() holds the transition, from and to; failing undoes the move.
ext.review_hint: A version runs only after someone other than its author approves it and it is deployed. Turning an extension off stops it at once.
ext.rollback_text: Version {n} replaces the newer version that is running now.
ext.sample_hint: A JSON object by field key, such as "subject": "Printer".
ext.sample_record_hint: The record's id; the sample values replace its values.
ext.save_before_test: Save first: the test runs the saved code.
ext.subtitle: Code for the rare cases the builder cannot cover: server hooks, custom API endpoints, and validators, field components and scripts that run in the browser. Every version is tested, approved by a second person and kept.
ext.test_hint_client: The code was compiled when saved; the test confirms it builds. It runs only in the browser's sandboxed frame.
ext.test_hint_server: It runs this exact code once: everything it writes is rolled back and nothing is sent out. Submitting needs a passed test.
ext.timeout_hint: From {min} to {max}; it is stopped after that.
ext.turned_off: Turned off: it no longer runs.
ext.type_hint.api_endpoint: PHP that answers /api/v1/ext-api/ followed by its key, for people who hold a chosen permission.
ext.type_hint.client_field: TypeScript (optionally Vue) that draws the input of a text field.
ext.type_hint.client_validator: TypeScript that checks the form before it is sent; the server still validates everything.
ext.type_hint.form_script: TypeScript that reacts to changes in the form, setting values and showing messages.
ext.type_hint.server_hook: PHP that runs on the server at one point of a record's life, inside its transaction.
ext.versions_hint: Every version is kept with its checksum, author, test and approval. Deploying an earlier approved version rolls back to it.
ext.waiting_approval: Waiting for someone who holds Approve code.
